blocks.zh: 3.1 §11.50 — Signature Manifestations: Three Mandatory Elements 3.1 §11.50 — 簽章表現形式：三項強制要素
blocks.en: 3.1 §11.50 — Signature Manifestations: Three Mandatory Elements

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 三元素缺一不可： §11.50 的三個元素必須「全部同時出現」在簽名相關的記錄中，才符合要求。
blocks.en: All three elements are indispensable: The three elements of §11.50 must "all appear together" in the signature-related record to meet the requirement.

blocks.zh: 元素 1 — 印刷姓名（Printed Name）： 「印刷」不是指必須從印表機輸出，而是指「清晰可辨的完整姓名字串」，對應手寫簽名的「可辨識性」。「John Doe」合規；「JD」或「jd01」不合規。
blocks.en: Element 1: Printed name: "Printed" does not mean the name must come out of a printer; it means a "clearly legible, full name string", corresponding to the "legibility" of a handwritten signature. "John Doe" is compliant; "JD" or "jd01" is not.

blocks.zh: 元素 2 — 自動時間戳記： 這個時間戳記必須由系統產生，不能是使用者手動輸入的日期欄位。如果系統允許使用者修改簽名時間，就違反了「computer-generated」的要求（§11.10e 同理）。
blocks.en: Element 2: Automatic time stamp: The time stamp must be generated by the system and cannot be a date field typed in by the user. If the system lets the user edit the signing time, it violates the "computer-generated" requirement (the same logic applies to §11.10(e)).

blocks.zh: 元素 3 — 簽名意義（最常被忽略）： 許多系統只顯示「Signed by: John Doe at 2026-04-11 09:23」，沒有說明「為什麼簽」。缺少這個元素使記錄無法判斷責任歸屬——「我簽名了」和「我批准了這個決定」是完全不同的法律含義。
blocks.en: Element 3: Meaning of the signature (the most often overlooked): Many systems display only "Signed by: John Doe at 2026-04-11 09:23", without stating "why it was signed". Without this element, the record cannot show where responsibility lies: "I signed" and "I approved this decision" have completely different legal meanings.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一份法院判決書。它必須包含：(1) 法官的全名（不是法院代碼）；(2) 判決日期和時間（由書記官記錄，不是法官自填）；(3) 判決性質（「駁回上訴」vs「判定有罪」vs「批准移轉管轄」）。三者缺一，判決的法律效力就不完整。§11.50 的電子簽名三要素邏輯完全相同。
blocks.en: Imagine a court judgment. It must include: (1) the judge's full name (not a court code); (2) the date and time of the judgment (recorded by the clerk, not filled in by the judge); (3) the nature of the judgment ("appeal dismissed" vs. "found guilty" vs. "transfer of jurisdiction approved"). If any one of the three is missing, the legal effect of the judgment is incomplete. The logic of the three elements of an electronic signature under §11.50 is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 3.2 §11.70 — Signature/Record Linking: Anti-Falsification 3.2 §11.70 — 簽章與紀錄連結：防偽造
blocks.en: 3.2 §11.70 — Signature/Record Linking: Anti-Falsification

blocks.zh: §11.70 的反偽造邏輯： 如果電子簽名只是一個「圖像」或「文字字串」附在記錄旁邊，任何有基本電腦技能的人都可以：複製這個圖像/字串 → 貼到另一份文件 → 得到一份看似有授權的偽造文件。
blocks.en: The anti-falsification logic of §11.70: If an electronic signature is just an "image" or a "text string" attached next to the record, anyone with basic computer skills can copy the image/string → paste it into another document → obtain a forged document that appears to be authorized.

blocks.zh: §11.70 要求「連結 (linked)」，意思是簽名必須在技術層面上與特定版本的記錄內容「綁定」，使得「簽名 + 記錄 A」的組合在技術上無法被轉移成「簽名 + 記錄 B」的有效組合。
blocks.en: §11.70 requires the signature to be "linked", meaning the signature must be technically "bound" to the content of a specific version of the record, so that the combination of "signature + record A" cannot technically be transferred into a valid combination of "signature + record B".

blocks.zh: 傳統的蠟封（wax seal）是一個好比喻：蠟封覆蓋信件開口，封蠟上有持有人的印章。如果你嘗試開封再重新封蠟，蠟封必然破損，無法恢復原狀，偽造一目了然。數位簽名的哈希值就是現代的蠟封——記錄內容改變了，哈希值就不對，「封蠟破損」立即可見。
blocks.en: The traditional wax seal is a good analogy: the wax covers the opening of the letter and carries the holder's seal. If you try to open it and re-seal it, the wax seal is bound to break and cannot be restored, so the forgery is obvious at a glance. The hash value of a digital signature is the modern wax seal: if the record content changes, the hash value no longer matches, and the "broken seal" is immediately visible.

blocks.zh: §11.70 在查廠中的評估方法
blocks.en: How §11.70 Is Assessed During Inspections

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠官員評估 §11.70 合規的常見方法：
blocks.en: Common methods FDA investigators use to assess §11.70 compliance:

blocks.zh: 方法 1： 要求列印一份批次記錄，然後問：「如果我把這個印刷版本的簽名掃描後，貼入另一份文件，系統能否偵測到？」——答案應該是「不需要偵測，因為印刷版本只是人眼可讀的副本；系統內的簽名綁定機制使電子記錄中的簽名無法被移植。」
blocks.en: Method 1: Ask for a batch record to be printed, then ask: "If I scan the signature on this printed version and paste it into another document, can the system detect it?" The answer should be: "It does not need to detect it, because the printed version is merely a human-readable copy; the signature binding mechanism inside the system means the signature in the electronic record cannot be transplanted."

blocks.zh: 方法 2： 嘗試修改一份已簽名的記錄，看系統是否阻止或強制重新簽名。
blocks.en: Method 2: Try to modify a signed record and see whether the system blocks the change or forces re-signing.

blocks.zh: 方法 3： 查看系統的技術文件，確認簽名機制（哈希值、版本鎖定、資料庫連結）的設計。
blocks.en: Method 3: Review the system's technical documentation to confirm the design of the signature mechanism (hash values, version locking, database linkage).

blocks.zh: 3.3 §11.100 — General Requirements: Uniqueness, Identity Verification & FDA Certification 3.3 §11.100 — 一般要求：唯一性、身分驗證與 FDA 認證
blocks.en: 3.3 §11.100 — General Requirements: Uniqueness, Identity Verification & FDA Certification

blocks.zh: §11.100(a) 唯一性的實務影響
blocks.en: Practical Impact of §11.100(a) Uniqueness

blocks.zh: 離職員工帳號管理： 當員工離職時，其帳號必須停用（不是刪除）。停用後的帳號不能分配給新員工，即使員工 ID 號碼格式相同。原因：稽核追蹤中已有大量與這個帳號關聯的記錄；如果帳號被重新分配，將來無法確定歷史操作是哪個真實的人所執行。
blocks.en: Managing accounts of departed employees: When an employee leaves, the account must be disabled (not deleted). A disabled account must not be reassigned to a new employee, even if the employee ID follows the same format. Reason: the audit trail already holds a large number of records linked to that account; if the account were reassigned, it would later be impossible to determine which real person performed the historical operations.

blocks.zh: 正確做法： 停用帳號 → 保留帳號（但設為「非活躍」狀態）→ 新員工建立全新帳號（即使有相似的姓名或工號前綴）
blocks.en: Correct practice: Disable the account → retain the account (set to "inactive" status) → create a brand-new account for the new employee (even if the name or ID prefix is similar)

blocks.zh: §11.100(c) FDA 認證信函詳解
blocks.en: The §11.100(c) FDA Certification Letter in Detail

blocks.zh: 這封信是什麼： 這是一份公司向 FDA 申報的聲明，說「我們公司使用電子簽名，而且我們理解並確認這些電子簽名在法律上等同於手寫簽名。」
blocks.en: What the letter is: A statement filed by the company with FDA saying, "Our company uses electronic signatures, and we understand and confirm that these electronic signatures are legally equivalent to handwritten signatures."

blocks.zh: 什麼時候寄： 「prior to or at the time of such use」——在第一次使用電子簽名之前，或使用時寄出。實務上，在 Part 11 系統正式啟用前寄出。
blocks.en: When to send it: "prior to or at the time of such use": before the first use of electronic signatures, or at the time of use. In practice, send it before the Part 11 system goes live.

blocks.zh: 寄給誰： FDA Office of Regional Operations (ORO)，參考 Docket No. 92S-0251。
blocks.en: Who to send it to: The FDA Office of Regional Operations (ORO), referencing Docket No. 92S-0251.

blocks.zh: 格式： 紙本（不是電子提交！），含公司官員的手寫簽名（諷刺的是：宣告電子簽名有效的信，本身必須用手寫簽名）。
blocks.en: Format: Paper (not an electronic submission!), with the handwritten signature of a company official (ironically, the letter declaring electronic signatures valid must itself carry a handwritten signature).

blocks.zh: 一封信涵蓋整個公司： 如果 Amaran Biotech 有三個系統（eBR、LIMS、SCADA），只需要寄一封信，不需要每個系統一封。
blocks.en: One letter covers the whole company: If Amaran Biotech has three systems (eBR, LIMS, SCADA), only one letter is needed, not one per system.

blocks.zh: 3.4 §11.200 — Electronic Signature Components and Controls 3.4 §11.200 — 電子簽章組成要素與管制
blocks.en: 3.4 §11.200 — Electronic Signature Components and Controls

blocks.zh: 連續作業 vs 非連續作業判斷
blocks.en: Determining Continuous vs. Non-Continuous Sessions

blocks.zh: 單一連續作業 (Single continuous period)： 操作員登入系統（使用帳號 + 密碼），在同一個工作階段中完成多個簽名動作——只需要在後續簽名時再輸入一次密碼（一個元件即可）。
blocks.en: Single continuous period of controlled system access: The operator logs in to the system (using user ID + password) and performs multiple signing actions in the same session; for subsequent signings, only the password needs to be entered again (one component is sufficient).

blocks.zh: 非連續情況（重新登入）： 以下情況必須重新使用兩個認證元件：
blocks.en: Non-continuous situations (re-login): In the following cases, both identification components must be used again:

blocks.zh: 工作階段超時（session timeout）自動登出後
blocks.en: After the session times out and the user is logged out automatically

blocks.zh: 操作員主動登出後再登入
blocks.en: After the operator logs out voluntarily and logs in again

blocks.zh: 從不同電腦或裝置登入
blocks.en: When logging in from a different computer or device

blocks.zh: 帳號被鎖定後重新解鎖
blocks.en: After the account has been locked and then unlocked

blocks.zh: 實務上的常見設計： 初次登入 = 帳號 + 密碼（兩個元件）；同一工作階段內的簽名 = 只需輸入密碼（一個元件）；工作階段超時（通常 15-30 分鐘無操作）= 再次要求帳號 + 密碼。
blocks.en: Common design in practice: Initial login = user ID + password (two components); signing within the same session = password only (one component); session timeout (usually 15-30 minutes of inactivity) = user ID + password required again.

blocks.zh: §11.200(a)(3) 的反共謀設計要求
blocks.en: The Anti-Collusion Design Requirement of §11.200(a)(3)

blocks.zh: 這條要求說：如果有人試圖使用別人的電子簽名，需要「兩個或兩個以上的人合謀」才能成功。這是一個技術上的防護設計要求：系統設計應確保，單靠一個未授權的人，無法在不被偵測的情況下使用他人的電子簽名。
blocks.en: This requirement states that an attempt to use another person's electronic signature must require "collaboration of two or more individuals" to succeed. It is a technical safeguard: the system should be designed so that one unauthorized person alone cannot use someone else's electronic signature without detection.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼帳號 + 密碼的組合在 Part 11 中被稱為「兩個元件 (two distinct identification components)」——如果要偷用別人的簽名，需要同時知道帳號「AND」密碼，必須要有兩方的資訊，不能只靠一個人單獨獲得全部資訊（理論上）。
blocks.en: This is why the user ID + password combination is called "two distinct identification components" in Part 11: to misuse another person's signature, you need to know both the user ID AND the password, which requires information from two parties; in theory, one person alone cannot obtain all of the information.

blocks.zh: §11.200 的連續作業規則就像銀行金庫的「雙鑰匙」制度：第一次開門，行長（帳號）+ 主管（密碼）兩把鑰匙都要用。一旦金庫開著，在同一個工作日內，只需要一把主管鑰匙就可以繼續存取。但如果金庫關上了（工作階段結束），下次要再開，必須再次使用兩把鑰匙。
blocks.en: The continuous-session rule of §11.200 is like the "two-key" system of a bank vault: to open the door the first time, both keys are needed, the branch manager's (user ID) and the supervisor's (password). Once the vault is open, within the same working day only the supervisor's key is needed to continue accessing it. But if the vault is closed (the session ends), both keys must be used again the next time it is opened.

blocks.zh: 3.5 §11.300 — Controls for Identification Codes/Passwords 3.5 §11.300 — 識別碼與密碼管制
blocks.en: 3.5 §11.300 — Controls for Identification Codes/Passwords

blocks.zh: §11.300 五個控制要素的實施框架
blocks.en: Implementation Framework for the Five §11.300 Control Elements

blocks.zh: (a) 唯一性： 系統在技術上不允許兩個用戶設置相同的帳號+密碼組合。大多數現代系統已自動實現（帳號唯一，密碼哈希儲存防止碰撞）。但需要 SOP 明確禁止重用舊帳號名稱。
blocks.en: (a) Uniqueness: The system technically does not allow two users to set the same user ID + password combination. Most modern systems already do this automatically (unique user IDs, with passwords stored as hashes to prevent collisions). However, an SOP is needed to explicitly prohibit reuse of old user IDs.

blocks.zh: (b) 定期更新： 密碼管理政策應包含：
blocks.en: (b) Periodic revision: The password management policy should include:

blocks.zh: 密碼有效期（建議：60-90 天）
blocks.en: Password validity period (recommended: 60-90 days)

blocks.zh: 密碼複雜度要求（長度≥8、大小寫、數字、特殊字元）
blocks.en: Password complexity requirements (length ≥ 8, upper and lower case, numbers, special characters)

blocks.zh: 密碼歷史記錄（禁止使用最近 10-24 個密碼）
blocks.en: Password history (prohibit reuse of the last 10-24 passwords)

blocks.zh: 初次登入強制更改（由 IT 設定的初始密碼）
blocks.en: Forced change at first login (for initial passwords set by IT)

blocks.zh: (c) 遺失管理（最關鍵的 SOP）：
blocks.en: (c) Loss management (the most critical SOP):

blocks.zh: 立即報告程序（員工發現憑證遺失/被盜立即通報）
blocks.en: Immediate reporting procedure (employees report lost/stolen credentials immediately)

blocks.zh: 立即停用帳號（不是等查明，而是即刻）
blocks.en: Immediate account deactivation (not after the facts are established, but at once)

blocks.zh: 重新身份驗證後發放新憑證
blocks.en: Issue new credentials after re-verification of identity

blocks.zh: 事件記錄和調查
blocks.en: Event recording and investigation

blocks.zh: (d) 交易保護： 技術實施：
blocks.en: (d) Transaction safeguards: Technical implementation:

blocks.zh: 連續N次（通常3-5次）登入失敗自動鎖定帳號
blocks.en: Automatic account lockout after N consecutive failed login attempts (usually 3-5)

blocks.zh: 鎖定事件即時通知系統安全人員（可用電子郵件或系統警報）
blocks.en: Lockout events are immediately notified to system security personnel (by email or system alert)

blocks.zh: 所有認證嘗試（成功和失敗）均記錄於稽核追蹤
blocks.en: All authentication attempts (successful and failed) are recorded in the audit trail

blocks.zh: (e) 裝置測試： 適用於硬體令牌（如 RSA SecurID、智慧卡、USB 金鑰）：初次發放前測試 + 定期測試是否正常運作 + 檢查是否有篡改跡象。
blocks.en: (e) Device testing: Applies to hardware tokens (such as RSA SecurID, smart cards, USB keys): test before initial issue + periodic testing that they work properly + check for signs of tampering.

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠密碼管控常見觀察
blocks.en: Common FDA Observations on Password Control

blocks.zh: 常見 FDA 483 觀察：
blocks.en: Common FDA 483 observations:

blocks.zh: 「系統管理員密碼未定期更換」
blocks.en: "System administrator passwords are not changed periodically"

blocks.zh: 「初始密碼未強制使用者在首次登入時更改」
blocks.en: "Initial passwords are not forced to be changed by users at first login"

blocks.zh: 「無書面程序定義憑證遺失/被盜的報告和處置流程」
blocks.en: "No written procedure defines the reporting and handling of lost/stolen credentials"

blocks.zh: 「登入失敗未觸發帳號鎖定」
blocks.en: "Failed logins do not trigger account lockout"

blocks.zh: 「系統允許使用者設定簡單密碼（如 '12345'）」
blocks.en: "The system allows users to set simple passwords (such as '12345')"

blocks.zh: 注意： §11.300 並未明文規定「密碼需 90 天更換」——但「periodically checked, recalled, or revised」的要求使定期更新密碼成為業界標準做法，FDA 查廠時會期待看到書面的密碼政策。
blocks.en: Note: §11.300 does not expressly say "passwords must be changed every 90 days", but the requirement that codes be "periodically checked, recalled, or revised" makes periodic password changes standard industry practice, and FDA inspectors will expect to see a written password policy.

blocks.zh: 3.6 Complete Part 11 Electronic Signature Compliance: End-to-End View 3.6 Part 11 電子簽章合規完整架構：端對端概覽
blocks.en: 3.6 Complete Part 11 Electronic Signature Compliance: End-to-End View

blocks.zh: 完整 Part 11 電子簽名合規路線圖
blocks.en: Complete Part 11 Electronic Signature Compliance Roadmap

blocks.zh: 使用前（系統建置期）：
blocks.en: Before use (system implementation phase):

1. Identity verification (§11.100(b)) → 2. Account provisioning (§11.10(d)) → 3. System validation (§11.10(a)) → 4. Written policies established (§11.10(j)) → 5. Personnel training (§11.10(i)) → 6. FDA certification letter (§11.100(c)) → 7. System go-live

blocks.zh: 簽名當下（操作期）：
blocks.en: At the moment of signing (operational phase):

blocks.zh: 1. 雙元件認證（§11.200a）→ 2. 系統自動附加三元素（§11.50）→ 3. 簽名綁定記錄（§11.70）→ 4. 稽核追蹤自動記錄（§11.10e）
blocks.en: 1. Two-component authentication (§11.200(a)) → 2. System automatically appends the three elements (§11.50) → 3. Signature bound to the record (§11.70) → 4. Audit trail records automatically (§11.10(e))

blocks.zh: 持續維護（日常運作期）：
blocks.en: Ongoing maintenance (routine operation phase):

blocks.zh: 定期密碼更新（§11.300b）+ 遺失立即停用（§11.300c）+ 異常監控（§11.300d）+ 定期稽核追蹤審查 + 帳號年度存取審查（§11.10d）
blocks.en: Periodic password revision (§11.300(b)) + immediate deactivation on loss (§11.300(c)) + anomaly monitoring (§11.300(d)) + periodic audit trail review + annual account access review (§11.10(d))

blocks.zh: Part 11 查廠準備清單
blocks.en: Part 11 Inspection Readiness Checklist

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠官員在審查電子簽名合規時，最常索取的文件：
blocks.en: When reviewing electronic signature compliance, the documents FDA investigators request most often:

blocks.zh: 系統驗證報告（含 Part 11 特定測試腳本）
blocks.en: System validation report (including Part 11-specific test scripts)

blocks.zh: 使用者帳號清單（含角色/權限、最後登入日、狀態）
blocks.en: User account list (including role/permissions, last login date, status)

blocks.zh: 密碼管理 SOP 和執行記錄
blocks.en: Password management SOP and execution records

blocks.zh: 電子簽名問責政策（§11.10j SOP）
blocks.en: Electronic signature accountability policy (§11.10(j) SOP)

blocks.zh: FDA 認證信函副本（§11.100c）
blocks.en: Copy of the FDA certification letter (§11.100(c))

blocks.zh: 稽核追蹤樣本（示範完整的簽名事件記錄）
blocks.en: Audit trail sample (demonstrating a complete signature event record)

blocks.zh: 近期訓練記錄（系統使用訓練）
blocks.en: Recent training records (system use training)

blocks.zh: 任何憑證遺失/異常事件的處置記錄
blocks.en: Records of handling of any credential loss/anomalous events

blocks.zh: 綜合練習 Comprehensive Practice
blocks.en: Comprehensive Practice

blocks.zh: 情境： FDA 查廠官員說：「我想看這批次（AMB-2026-0411）批次記錄的 QA 批准簽名。請向我說明這個電子簽名如何符合 Part 11 的要求。」
blocks.en: Scenario: An FDA investigator says: "I would like to see the QA approval signature on the batch record for this batch (AMB-2026-0411). Please explain how this electronic signature meets the requirements of Part 11."

blocks.zh: 你的完整回答應涵蓋：
blocks.en: Your complete answer should cover:

blocks.zh: §11.50：展示簽名顯示了哪些資訊（姓名、時間、意義）
blocks.en: §11.50: show what information the signature displays (name, date/time, meaning)

blocks.zh: §11.70：解釋簽名如何技術上綁定到這份批次記錄
blocks.en: §11.70: explain how the signature is technically bound to this batch record

blocks.zh: §11.200：說明 QA 主任是如何認證身份才能執行這個簽名
blocks.en: §11.200: explain how the QA director's identity was authenticated to execute this signature

blocks.zh: §11.100：確認 QA 主任的帳號是唯一且經過身份驗證後建立的
blocks.en: §11.100: confirm that the QA director's account is unique and was created after identity verification

blocks.zh: §11.10(e)：展示稽核追蹤記錄了這個簽名事件的完整資訊
blocks.en: §11.10(e): show that the audit trail recorded the complete information of this signing event

blocks.zh: 本章重點總結
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: §11.50 三元素缺一不可： 電子簽名必須自動顯示（1）完整印刷姓名、（2）系統產生的時間戳記、（3）明確的簽名意義（審查/批准/撰寫/驗證）。「簽名意義」是最常被忽略的元素，也是 FDA 查廠的關注點。
blocks.en: All three §11.50 elements are indispensable: An electronic signature must automatically display (1) the full printed name, (2) a system-generated time stamp, and (3) a clear meaning of the signature (review/approval/authorship/verification). The "meaning of the signature" is the element most often overlooked and a focus of FDA inspections.

blocks.zh: §11.70 簽名連結防偽造： 簽名必須技術上綁定至特定版本的記錄，使「簽名剪貼」偽造在技術上不可能或即刻可偵測。密碼學哈希值和記錄鎖定是主流實施方式。
blocks.en: §11.70 signature linking prevents falsification: The signature must be technically bound to a specific version of the record, so that "signature cut-and-paste" falsification is technically impossible or immediately detectable. Cryptographic hash values and record locking are the mainstream implementations.

blocks.zh: §11.100(c) FDA 認證信函是公司級義務： 首次使用電子簽名前，公司需寄紙本信函至 FDA（Docket No. 92S-0251），聲明電子簽名是手寫簽名的法律等效物。一封信覆蓋整個公司的所有系統。
blocks.en: The §11.100(c) FDA certification letter is a company-level obligation: Before first using electronic signatures, the company must send a paper letter to FDA (Docket No. 92S-0251) stating that electronic signatures are the legal equivalent of handwritten signatures. One letter covers all of the company's systems.

blocks.zh: §11.200 雙元件認證： 非生物特徵簽名需要帳號+密碼兩個元件。連續工作階段的後續簽名可用單元件（僅密碼）；每次新工作階段（包括超時後）必須重新使用雙元件。§11.300 進一步要求完整的密碼管控框架（唯一性、定期更新、遺失處理、交易保護、裝置測試）。
blocks.en: §11.200 two-component authentication: Non-biometric signatures need two components, user ID + password. Subsequent signings in a continuous session may use one component (password only); every new session (including after a timeout) requires both components again. §11.300 further requires a complete password control framework (uniqueness, periodic revision, loss handling, transaction safeguards, device testing).
